thesis: Aptiv trades at 7.7-7.9x the midpoint of its own guided FY26 adjusted EPS of 5.60-5.80 after an early-August guidance cut took the FY revenue midpoint down 300M on weak Chinese domestic demand, softer European export schedules and software timing. The reason to own it is what management did next: four insiders including CEO Hakan Agnevall put 8.61M of their own money into the stock on 2026-08-11 to 08-13, which is after the cut, not before it, while the company retired 325M of shares year to date and used a 1.9B dividend from the April Versigent spin-off to redeem debt early.
key_risk: The cut may not be finished. Goldman kept a Buy but cut its target to 61 specifically because weaker Chinese vehicle sales could pressure suppliers further, and the sell side is already walking back - bullish share fell 11 points in four months. A second guidance reduction on 2026-11-03 would reset the 7.7x multiple against a lower number rather than vindicate it, and with no hard stop the position takes that gap in full.
counter_argument: Analyst revision direction is deteriorating, not improving: 19 buy ratings in July became 15 in October, and the stock is down 43% from its July high having spent four straight months falling. Buying a falling knife on an insider cluster is exactly the trade that looks obvious in hindsight either way, and the insiders are themselves already down 9-12% on their August purchases.

thesis: Aptiv trades at 7.7-7.9x the midpoint of its own guided FY26 adjusted EPS of 5.60-5.80, after an early-August cut took the full-year revenue midpoint down 300M on weak Chinese domestic demand, softer European export schedules and software timing. The reason to own it is what the board did next: four distinct insiders - CEO Hakan Agnevall, Kevin P Clark, Paul M Meister and Sean O Mahoney - bought 8.61M of stock open-market between 2026-08-11 and 08-13, after the cut rather than before it, against 365K of sales. Meanwhile the company retired 325M of its own shares year to date and used a 1.9B dividend from the April Versigent spin-off to redeem debt early.
key_risk: The cut may not be finished. Goldman kept a Buy but cut its target to 61 precisely because weaker Chinese vehicle sales could pressure suppliers further, and the sell side is already walking back - bullish share fell 11 points in four months. A second guidance reduction on 2026-11-03 resets the 7.7x multiple against a lower number rather than vindicating it, and with no hard stop the position absorbs that gap in full.
counter_argument: Analyst revision direction is deteriorating, not improving: 19 buy ratings in July became 15 by October, and the stock is down 43% from its July high after four consecutive months of falling. All four insiders are already 9-12% underwater on their August purchases, which is either the signal or the warning depending on whether the China cycle has bottomed - and I have no evidence that it has.
